تقترضين (form VIII)
# تَقْتَرِضِينَ (taqtariḍīna) /taq.ta.ri.dˤiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
# تُقْتَرَضِينَ (tuqtaraḍīna) /tuq.ta.ra.dˤiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
